items.hook: The 1989 Victorian Football League finals series was the 93rd annual edition of the VFL/AFL final series, the Australian rules football tournament staged to determine the winner of the 1989 VFL Premiership season.
items.body: The series ran over four weekends in September 1989, culminating with the 1989 VFL Grand Final at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on 30 September 1989. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Allergic reactions after sex should be listed as an antibiotic risk, experts say
items.body: A woman developed a severe allergic reaction to an antibiotic in her partner's semen after sex, prompting clinicians to call for this risk to be listed on the drug's patient information leaflet

items.hook: Gualtieri di San Lazzaro (1904–1974) was an Italian writer and art publisher.
items.body: For the majority of his life, he resided in Paris where he published monographs focusing on the work of contemporary French and Italian artists. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The UK Home Office hostile environment policy is a set of administrative and legislative measures designed to make staying in the United Kingdom as difficult as possible for people without leave to remain, in the hope that they may "voluntarily leave".
items.body: The Home Office policy was first announced in 2012 under the Conservative–Liberal Democrat coalition. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Daphne Gail Fautin was an American professor of invertebrate zoology at the University of Kansas, specializing in sea anemones and symbiosis.
items.body: She is world-renowned for her extensive work studying and classifying sea anemones and related species. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: You Will Get Through This Night is a 2021 non-fiction book written by British YouTuber and author Daniel Howell, in consultation with psychologist Dr Heather Bolton.
items.body: It is described as "a practical guide to taking control of your mental health for today, tomorrow, and the days after". The world is stranger than it lets on.
